out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the back handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CDI: CFM placed paper towels at hand sink.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: overcrowded container diced tomatoes (54F) 2 DWR UC refrigerator (front omelette area).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: CFM removed portion of diced tomatoes from container and relocated both containers of diced tomatoes to walk in refrigerator to cool to 41F or below.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: squeeze bottles on cookline (oil, vinegar, cookline wine, etc.) and dry food (croutons, bread crumbs, sugar, etc.).
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS instructed CFM to label all food items removed from original container and not easily identifiable.

violations.title: Mechanical Warewashing, Sanitization Pressure
violations.observation: The pressure gauge for the high temperature warewashing machine was below 5 PSI or above 30 PSI.
violations.corrective_action: The flow pressure of the fresh hot water sanitizing rinse in a warewashing machine shall be within the range specified on the machine manufacturer's data plate and may not be less than 5 PSI or more than 30 PSI as measured in the water line immediately downstream or upstream from the fresh hot water sanitizing rinse control valve. EHS instructed CFM to schedule service for repair on the pressure gauge at the HT dish machine to ensure the PSI is between 5- 30psi.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: diced honeydew and cantaloupe melon) inside American panel walk-in refrigerator (m).
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CDI: CFM placed date mark on cut melons (7 days remaining).

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Dead or Trapped Pest Removed
violations.observation: Observed one dead roach on shelf across from HT dish machine in the kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Remove dead rodents, birds, and insects from the premises to ensure that the establishment is clean and sanitary and to prevent carcasses from attracting other pests. CDI: CFM stated that Ecolab treated the kitchen on Monday and is already scheduled to treat the area again this upcoming Monday.
